record.notes: VERIFIED 2026-10-24. It is real and it is orderable: the product page is live, the contract table and the vendor's own forum confirm the free model, and a non-EU country is selectable at registration. The contract is one month with manual renewal, the vendor answers 'yes' to 'do I renew by hand every month', and 'server becomes down' if you forget. Calling it 'free forever' is wrong; it is free for as long as a human renews it monthly, and the renewal now needs an emailed PIN. (2) IPv4: the free model includes NONE - the row is a dash - and IPv4 is an optional paid add-on ('additional IPv4 | EUR per IP / mo | yes, optional up to 16'). The price is a dash here because the page renders it client-side from an endpoint that returned the same figure for every row id tried, so the answer could not be attributed to the IPv4 row and was discarded rather than recorded. (3) The registration form asks for a date of birth and a country but NOT a postal address or phone; those go into the customer panel afterwards, and third-party guides report the order stays ineffective until they are filled in. No ID document is requested. The German page carries the same table, so the terms are not an English-only rendering. Signup URL: https://www.euserv.com/en/register.php, then the order link on the product page.
